Plan this trip and keep every named place. Party size 2, origin Hong Kong, 6–8 March 2027, 3 days, budget 12000, currency HKD.

Day 1 (Mar 6, Sat) | Arrival in Japan → Naritasan Shinshoji Temple

Arrive at Narita Airport, drop off luggage, or check in at your hotel.
Visit Naritasan Shinshoji Temple, stroll along Omotesando historic street, and eat grilled eel over rice (unadon) at Kawatoyo.
Stay the night in Kaihin-Makuhari.
Day 2 (Mar 7, Sun) | Full day at Mother Farm

Pick up a rental car in Chiba in the morning.
Spend the day at Mother Farm with the capybaras and alpacas, see the March rapeseed flower (nanohana) fields, and eat inside the park.
Drive to Kisarazu for the night.
Day 3 (Mar 8, Mon) | Mount Nokogiri, then fly home

Take the Mount Nokogiri ropeway to the cliffside observatory, the Nihon-ji Great Buddha, and the 1,500 Rakan stone statues.
Drive back to Chiba City, return the rental car, and fly out of Narita Airport in the evening.
